prose: Tonight we have two of the great pioneers of energetic medicine converging for a legendary collaboration. Eileen Day McKusick is the founder of the Biofield Tuning organization and thought leader in modeling the anatomy of human energy fields. We're also joined by Austin Walters, a Biomagnetism teacher and practitioner. This will be a truly unique conversation, sure to expand your understanding of the aura!
